code:
-- Querying fundamentals (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY,
--   window functions) are remarkably portable.
--
-- Procedural code (stored procs, functions, triggers,
--   error handling) is where the real divergence lives.
caption: Every chapter in this course, in the end, was evidence for one of these two halves.

code:
WITH some_cte AS (
  SELECT col, SUM(value) AS total
  FROM some_table
  GROUP BY col
)
SELECT col, total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC)
FROM some_cte;
-- This shape barely changes, platform to platform.
caption: Lesson 60 proved it with a real reporting query, side by side, on four platforms.

code:
-- T-SQL fluency does NOT auto-transfer to a new
--   platform's procedural idioms -- and that's fine.
-- Treat each platform's procedural layer as its own
--   thing to learn on purpose.
caption: Recognize the shape of the question: querying (fast) or procedural (deliberate).
